glue.description: configure the server's request timeout (a cap on wall time, not a bound on work)

measurements.transport: loopback HTTP to opa run --server (includes TCP and JSON, no in process Python embedding exists)

notes: opa run --server over loopback HTTP, 100000 requests: min/median/p95/max ns 99840/316193/555632/1495697; includes the HTTP round trip and JSON on both sides. Rego evaluation has no stated worst case bound and no bound travels with a policy; a request timeout caps wall time, which the pre registered rubric counts as WITH-WORK.
